summary: Payment Reversal feature fully tested and working. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend Super Admin Portal Reversals tab and Finance Dashboard PaymentsTab/CreditNotesTab display correctly show reversed payments and voided credit notes with proper badges and styling.
seed_data_creation: Test payment created and reversed during testing (RM 2,000 with 4% credit note)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment Reversal feature is fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/superadmin/payments-for-reversal, GET /api/superadmin/payment-reversal/preview/{payment_id}, POST /api/superadmin/payment-reversal/execute, GET /api/superadmin/payment-reversals, GET /api/superadmin/audit-trail/{entity_type}/{entity_id}. Super Admin Portal is at /superadmin (NOT /super-admin). Test invoice ID for TELAGAMAS MOBILITY SDN BHD: ce0c89c3-f077-447e-aa56-45591b0e1c8c

backend_api_tests.details: All 18 tests passed including: login, access control (403 for non-super-admin), payments-for-reversal list, payment-reversals history, preview endpoint, execute endpoint validation, full reversal flow (create payment -> preview -> execute -> verify), audit trail

access_control_403.details: Non-super-admin users (coordinator role) correctly receive 403 Forbidden on all reversal endpoints

preview_endpoint.details: Preview shows payment info, invoice info, linked credit notes, linked journal entries, and summary with invoice status change

execute_endpoint.details: Execute requires confirm=true and reason (min 10 chars). Returns reversal_id, actions_taken list, and summary

reversal_history.details: Reversal history shows all past reversals with date, company, receipt #, amount, reversed_by_name, and reason

audit_trail.details: Audit trail endpoint returns logs from super_admin_audit_log, finance_audit_log, and audit_trail collections

frontend_superadmin_reversals_tab.details: Super Admin Portal Reversals tab shows: Payment Reversal section with table (Receipt #, Company, Invoice, Amount, Date, Method, Action), Reversal History section with past reversals

frontend_payments_tab_reversed_badge.details: Finance PaymentsTab shows REVERSED badge (red) with strikethrough amount styling for reversed payments. Reversal reason displayed below each reversed payment.

frontend_credit_notes_voided_badge.details: Finance CreditNotesTab shows 'voided' badge (red) for voided credit notes. Void reason displayed showing 'Payment reversal: [reason]'. Filter dropdown includes 'Voided' option.

multi_step_confirmation_flow.details: Frontend implements 3-step flow: 1. Review (preview impact), 2. Reason (enter mandatory reason), 3. Complete (confirmation). Step indicator visible in UI.
